messages:
maya: Ran a focused KV-cache benchmark across regions (us-east1 / eu-west1 / ap-southeast1) and GPUs (g5 / a100 / h100). Wanted to surface a few surprising tradeoffs we saw on mixed seqlen workloads.

maya: High-level TL;DR:
- Paging thrash appears for mixes with >8% sequences >2048 tokens.
- Fused KV kernel -> consistent p99 wins on h100 for long sequences (~15% lower) but +~600MB/shard memory.
- On g5, fused kernel improves throughput but increases tail on medium seqs due to kernel launch variance.
- LFU-like eviction sweep (interval tuned) reduced tail by ~20% vs plain LRU under heavy write churn.

arjun: Nice. can you drop the core numbers? p50/p95/p99 + hit rates per GPU/region?

maya: Paste from run summary (condensed):
```
Config: model=redwood-7b, quant=int8, batch=8, async_prefetch=on
SeqDist: short(<=64)=55%, mid(65-512)=35%, long(>512)=10%
Regions/GPU: us-east1(a100), eu-west1(h100), ap-southeast1(g5)

us-east1 @ a100 -> hit_rate=0.82, p50=9ms, p95=48ms, p99=180ms
eu-west1 @ h100 -> hit_rate=0.80, p50=6ms, p95=35ms, p99=150ms (fused_kv)
ap-southeast1 @ g5 -> hit_rate=0.79, p50=11ms, p95=60ms, p99=230ms

Note: when forcing non-fused kernel on h100 p99 -> 175ms; fused_kv shows best long-seq p99.
```

chen: What were the eviction params and page size? That paging thrash number sounds bad.

maya: Default page=64k, eviction=LRU, eviction_target=0.75 (start evicting when cache >75% capacity). For the sweep test we tried: sweep_interval=30s, min_age=5s, policy=LFU-ish (approx counter + periodic decay). That sweep decreased p99 by ~20% in high-write tests where churn was ~30k keys/s.

sam: Did you try raising page size to 128k to reduce metadata churn? Also curious about bandwidth saturation on inter-node fetches for paging.

maya: Yes: 128k reduced CPU overhead but increased GPU memory pressure and slightly worsened p50 for short seqs. Inter-node paging bandwidth peaked ~6.2GB/s on a100 across the worst case; h100 with fused_kv kept bandwidth lower due to better local aggregation.

arjun: Any kernel-choice routing ideas? e.g., route fused_kv for predicted long sequences only?

maya: We tested a hybrid: predict seq_len at request start -> route to fused_kv on h100 if >512 and to matmul-path otherwise. Hybrid gave best overall p99 without the global mem hit. Implementation notes: need per-route memory reservations and dynamic shard placement to avoid OOMs.

deploy-bot: Benchmark run completed: artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/1781234567/ (logs, flamegraphs, perf traces).

infra-bot: Cluster note: all tests ran on the dedicated bench pool (12 nodes), no other tenants. Repro script: `bench/run_kv.py --profile mixed_seqlen --regions eu-west1,us-east1,ap-southeast1 --gpus a100,h100,g5 --evict-sweep=30s`

chen: Good. Can you attach the p99-by-seqlen chart? we need it for the onboarding doc.

maya: Uploaded a quick chart snapshot to the artifacts path mentioned by deploy-bot. Short summary: p99 rises steeply after 1024 tokens; fused_kv delays the knee by ~30% on h100. Will add a perm link to the onboarding PR.

sam: Action items: (1) add hybrid kernel routing prototype to canary (2) add eviction sweep config to default profiles for high-churn workloads (3) update model-onboarding checklist to run this mixed-seqlen bench.

maya: Agreed. I'll open the PR with flags and the bench script + perf notes. cc @arjun for canary rollout plan. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

arjun: Thanks — can you drop the PR link when ready? want to coordinate with infra for reservation sizes.

maya: Will do, aim to have PR + perf artifacts by EOD tomorrow.
